title: Distorted or Fabricated? A Survey on Hallucination in Video LLMs

layout.note: A narrow grey panel for the image-level baseline at left, a dashed vertical divider, and a wide grey panel for video hallucinations at right; the wide panel holds a blue and an orange region side by side with two stacked cards each, every card ordered title, icon and frames, arrow, caption box.

lesson: Teach a failure taxonomy with one card per type: a concept icon, a three-frame strip with time labels, an arrow and the model's wrong sentence with the hallucinated words in red capitals; put the familiar image-level case at the left behind a dashed divider so the new video types read as an extension.
